passages.title: Hortatory Exposition: Arguing for Action
passages.text: Students should practise respectful communication in online school groups. Short messages can be misunderstood because readers cannot hear the speaker’s tone. Personal insults may discourage classmates from asking questions, even when they have useful ideas. Respectful disagreement makes discussion more productive. Therefore, before sending a reply, students should check whether it addresses an idea rather than attacking a person. They should also report harmful messages through the school’s established channels instead of spreading screenshots for entertainment.
